method: Qualitative diagnosis from the valid Phase 5B retry plus three independently labelled AC-05 diagnostic stability probes; not an automated Diagnosis Service.

candidate_v2.observed_pattern: The candidate repeatedly performs serial root/service discovery, a workspace reference search, rename/update, repeat search, and separate JSON parsing after the reference result is already sufficient.

baseline.observed_pattern: The baseline commonly searches first and completes the same workspace state in six model calls; one independent run also crosses the budget, so the case is budget-sensitive.

root_cause.why: The candidate's repeated eight-call pattern persists across all observations despite all four task Oracles passing. Its extra cost is primarily two model rounds, not a requirement imposed by an Oracle failure or an additional fixture change. Baseline variability remains a confounder, so the change is a bounded hypothesis rather than a claim of determinism.

candidate_change.generic_rule: For cross-file renames or identifier replacements, discover scope with a focused identifier search, batch supported updates, and reuse completed-update/reference-search evidence while retaining a structural check when it is necessary.
preserved_rules: one necessary verification and stop condition
prohibited_shortcuts: budget, Oracle, GatePolicy, model, toolset or fixture changes

re_evaluation_plan: Freeze Candidate v3 as a new lineage, then run the unchanged five-case paired suite once. Any subsequent stability probe remains separate and never replaces the main attempt.
